text.en:
No. S 115

THE MUNICIPAL BOARD ENACTMENT (Cap. 57) Names of Streets in Municipal Area Belait In exercise of the powers conferred upon him by subsection (b) of section 4 of the Municipal Board Cap. 57. Enactment, the Mentri Besar has approved the naming of streets in the Belait Municipal Area as follows:- i) Commencing from junction with Jalan Penglima in the West to junction with [alan Puteri Berunai in the East. Jalan Maharaja Anakda ii) Commencing from junction with [alan Setia Negara in the North and ending in a cul-de-sac at Lot No. 2444 in the South. Jalan Maharaja Lela iii) Commencing from junction with [alan Paduka Yuan in the North and ending in cul-de-sac at Lot No. 2447 in the South. Jalan Maharaja Setia. iv) Commencing at junction with Jalan Peng­ lima in the West to junction with Jalan Setia Negara in the East. Jalan Paduka Tuan v) Commencing at junction with Jalan Jaya Negara in the North to junction with [alan Setia Di-Raja in the South. Jalan Setia Negara vi) Commencing at junction with [alan. Peng­ lima in the West to junction with Jalan Setia Pahlawan in the East Jalan Jaya Negara vii) Commencing at junction with [alan Setia Negara in the West to junction with [alan Setia Pahlawan in the East. Jalan Kerma Negara PENGlRAN 1'fOl\I1N State Secretary, Brunei. [Ref.: SDK. 257/47AJ
